usual_baseline: Severity score documented in a minority. 0/51 at one DGH [2801], 10% [2736], 16.7% [2857], 17% [2725], 33% [2444] and 44% [2548]. Scores that are done are often used wrongly, and high scores are rarely escalated (17% [2548]).
fix_that_works: A score built into clerking. An electronic tick box took scoring from 44% to 84% and escalation of scores ≥3 from 17% to 100% [2548]. BISAP printed on the clerking proforma: 10% to 80% [2736]. Teaching plus an on-call process to score every new admission: 16.7% to 81.8% [2857].
fix_that_fails: Teaching, posters and an electronic template only reached 30% from 17% [2725]. Presentation, posters and email alone reached 66% before the tick box was added [2548]. An e-care proforma was used in 66.6%, but only 7/18 were fully completed [2801].
consultant_advice: Every audit finds the same thing and the same fix. Only repeat it if your clerking has no built-in score. More useful: audit whether scores ≥3 are escalated in time, or whether CT is being requested without indication, which one unit found in almost half [2444].
